### Flood Fill

Type `floodFill`.

Finds the separate white regions of a mask (joined across the texture's edges) and stores each texel's region box, for the Fill To nodes. Feed those directly: they read it at its own resolution. Runs as its own pass.

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | gray | input | `0` | Regions are where this is over 0.5. |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `passes` |  | `4` | GPU sweeps; more resolve winding regions. The CPU result is always exact. |

## Generator

### AO Darken

Type `genAoDarken`.

A mask of the occluded areas from ambient occlusion, for darkening or tinting them.

### Cavity Grime

Type `genCavityGrime`.

Grime packed into crevices and tight corners (cavity, a little ambient occlusion), with fine grain.

### Dirt

Type `genDirt`.

Dirt gathering where the surface is occluded (ambient occlusion and cavities), broken up by a dirt noise.

### Drips

Type `genDrips`.

Streaks running down vertical surfaces (directional noise along v, masked to walls by the world normal).

### Dust

Type `genDust`.

Dust settling top-down on upward-facing surfaces, less where they are occluded, broken up by clouds.

### Edge Wear

Type `genEdgeWear`.

Wear on convex edges from curvature, broken up by noise.

### ID Select

Type `genIdSelect`.

White where the baked ID map is exactly the picked colour.

### Moss

Type `genMoss`.

Moss and growth on upward-facing surfaces, favouring sheltered (occluded) areas, in patches.

### Paint Chips

Type `genPaintChips`.

Hard-edged chips knocked out of paint, clustered on convex edges.

### Polygon Fill

Type `genPolygonFill`.

Fills whole UV islands or material/object/group IDs (the ID map's source) picked by colour, up to four.

### Position Gradient

Type `genPositionGradient`.

A gradient along an axis of the bake bounds (0 at start, 1 at end), optionally warped by noise.

### Rust Spread

Type `genRustSpread`.

Rust starting in crevices and on worn edges and spreading out through noise as spread rises.

### Scratches

Type `genScratches`.

Fine scratches, stronger on exposed surfaces (less where occluded).

### Sun Bleach

Type `genSunBleach`.

Fading on surfaces facing the sun, less where they are occluded.

### Thickness

Type `genThickness`.

A mask from the thickness map: thin parts (inverted) for subsurface, light bleed or wear.

### UV Island Random

Type `genUvIslandRandom`.

A random value per UV island (from the uvIslands map), for per-plank or per-panel variation.

### Wetness

Type `genWetness`.

Wet from a water line up (along an axis of the bake bounds) plus puddles on upward-facing surfaces.

## Group

### Group

Runs a graph from the set's subgroups, named by its group value.

### Group Input

The graph's port inputs, as outputs inside it.

### Group Output

What the graph hands back to the node using it.

## Layer

### Layer Blend

Type `layerBlend`.

Composites a layer's channel over the stack below it: the blend mode result, mixed in by mask times opacity. addSigned adds around 0.5 (heights).

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `below` | color | input | `[0, 0, 0, 1]` |  |
| `above` | color | input | `[1, 1, 1, 1]` |  |
| `mask` | gray | input | `1` |  |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `normal`, `add`, `subtract`, `multiply`, `screen`, `overlay`, `darken`, `lighten`, `difference`, `softLight`, `addSigned` | `normal` |  |
| `opacity` |  | `1` |  |

### Layer Blend Normal

Type `layerBlendNormal`.

Composites a layer's tangent-space normal over the normals below: rnm reorients the layer's detail onto them, normal replaces them. Mixed in by mask times opacity.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `below` | color | input | `[0.5, 0.5, 1, 1]` |  |
| `above` | color | input | `[0.5, 0.5, 1, 1]` |  |
| `mask` | gray | input | `1` |  |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `rnm`, `normal` | `rnm` |  |
| `opacity` |  | `1` |  |

### Layer Height Mask

Type `layerHeightMask`.

Height-aware layer mask: the layer shows first where its height stands above the stack's, so it fills cracks last and tops bumps first. Sharpness narrows the transition.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mask` | gray | input | `1` |  |

| `out` | gray | output |  |  |

## Layout

### Receive

Type `PortalReceive`.

Reads the value of the Send node with its name, without a wire. Takes that value's type.

### Reroute

A point a wire passes through, to steer it. Takes the type of whatever feeds it and can feed several inputs.

### Send

Type `PortalSend`.

Names the value wired into it, so Receive nodes anywhere in the graph can read it without a wire.

## Scatter

### Splatter

Type `splatter`.

Scatters several copies of the pattern per cell at random positions, sizes and rotations, for pebbles, leaves and decals. The mask drives density (and size, with mask size). Per-instance outputs: random colour, uv inside the instance (z is 1 on an instance), random value, rotation and size.

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pattern` | gray | input | `1` | Sampled in each instance's own 0 to 1 uv. |
| `mask` | gray | input | `1` | Instance density, read at each instance's centre. |
| `out` | gray | output |  |  |
| `color` | color | output |  |  |
| `instanceUv` | vector | output |  |  |
| `random` | gray | output |  |  |
| `rotation` | gray | output |  |  |
| `size` | gray | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `countX` |  | `6` | Cells across u. |
| `countY` |  | `6` | Cells across v. |
| `perCell` |  | `3` | Instances in each cell. |
| `size` |  | `0.6` | Instance size, a fraction of the cell. |
| `sizeRandom` |  | `0.4` |  |
| `rotation` |  | `0` | Instance rotation, degrees. |
| `rotationRandom` |  | `1` |  |
| `offsetRandom` |  | `1` | How far instances wander from their cell centre. |
| `valueRandom` |  | `0.3` | Random darkening per instance. |
| `maskSize` |  | `0` | How much the mask shrinks instances, as well as thinning them. |
| `blend` | `max`, `add`, `top` | `top` | Where instances overlap: the brightest, their sum, or the topmost. |
| `seed` |  | `0` | Changes the pattern without changing its look. |

### Tiler

Type `tiler`.

Places one copy of the pattern in every cell of a grid, each with its own random offset, size, rotation and value. The mask thins out instances (sampled at each one's centre). Per-instance outputs: random colour, uv inside the instance (z is 1 on an instance), random value, rotation and size.

## Utility

### Buffer

Type `buffer`.

Caches its input in a texture, so what feeds it is computed once and not per read.

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | color | input | `[0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1]` |  |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |

### Pixel Processor

Type `pixelProcessor`.

Runs a Slang function body per texel: it sees uv, inputs a and b (colours) and c and d (grays) as a.sample(uv), the values x, y, z and w as p.x, and texel(), and returns a float4. Editing the code recompiles; the values don't.

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `a` | color | input | `[0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1]` |  |
| `b` | color | input | `[0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1]` |  |
| `c` | gray | input | `0.5` |  |
| `d` | gray | input | `0.5` |  |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expression` |  | `float4 col = a.sample(uv);
return float4(col.rgb * p.x, col.a);` | Slang statements ending in a return of a float4. |
| `x` |  | `1` |  |
| `y` |  | `0` |  |
| `z` |  | `0` |  |
| `w` |  | `0` |  |

One random value and colour for the whole texture, from a seed: expose the seed to vary several nodes together.
